purpose: Resolve the selected market-direction-conditional dependence concept into one exact no-value mechanism and challenge it against terminal and prospective families before any Campaign026 source partition, frozen benchmark value, candidate value, comparison value, daily price, or forward return is opened.

selected_mechanism.name: intraday_market_up_down_correlation_asymmetry_238m
selected_mechanism.formula: population PearsonCorr(stock_return, leave_one_out_market_return | leave_one_out_market_return>0) minus population PearsonCorr(stock_return, leave_one_out_market_return | leave_one_out_market_return<0) over exactly 238 within-half return positions
selected_mechanism.economic_hypothesis: A higher value means the stock participates more consistently in synchronous broad-market rises than in synchronous broad-market declines, representing upside participation with relative downside resilience that may carry from the next open through the third close.
selected_mechanism.return_grid: Form 119 adjacent log-close returns inside each 120-close half at 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00, concatenate morning then afternoon into exactly 238 positions, and exclude standalone 09:30 and the lunch transition.
selected_mechanism.leave_one_out_rule: At each return position subtract the stock's own finite return and count from the frozen equal-weight market return sum and valid-stock count, then divide the remaining sum by the remaining count.
selected_mechanism.peer_rule: Require at least 50 other finite stock returns at every one of the 238 positions.
selected_mechanism.market_sign_rule: Use the exact sign of each synchronous leave-one-out market return. Positive positions enter only the up correlation, negative positions enter only the down correlation, and exact-zero positions enter neither subset.
selected_mechanism.minimum_sign_support: Require at least 30 positive-market and 30 negative-market return positions for the stock-day.
selected_mechanism.correlation_rule: Use equal-pair-weight population Pearson correlation separately inside the positive-market and negative-market subsets. Retain exact-zero stock returns. Require positive population variance in both the stock and market vectors in both subsets.
selected_mechanism.asymmetry_rule: Subtract the negative-market correlation from the positive-market correlation. Do not use beta, covariance, regression intercepts, magnitude weights, leads, lags, thresholds, quantiles, or subwindows.
selected_mechanism.endpoint_rule: Canonicalize only values within 1e-12 beyond -2 or +2 to that endpoint; otherwise any nonfinite value or value outside [-2,2] is missing.
selected_mechanism.missing_rule: Any invalid close-return grid, insufficient leave-one-out peers, fewer than 30 observations in either nonzero market-sign subset, degenerate correlation component, nonfinite score, or out-of-range score makes the stock-day missing; never fill, clip statistically, repair, or substitute.

overlap_challenges.reason: Market-idiosyncratic share decomposes unconditional whole-session variance against a synchronous market path. Campaign026 keeps the synchronous path but compares two market-sign-conditional correlations and does not estimate residual variance.

The terminal residual-drift mechanism uses a fitted whole-session market relation to measure late residual direction. Campaign026 uses no late window, fitted residual, or drift and instead compares full-session conditional correlations.
Campaign021 subtracts one-minute stock-lag and stock-lead cross correlations. Campaign026 is strictly synchronous at each of 238 positions, has no lead or lag, and partitions only by market sign.
Those mechanisms measure the stock's own unconditional return-distribution asymmetry. Campaign026 conditions a bivariate dependence statistic on an external leave-one-out market state.
Sign-run imbalance measures adjacent own-return sign persistence. Campaign026 retains return magnitude inside correlations, uses no adjacent sign pairs, and conditions on synchronous market sign.
Amount-profile synchronization compares normalized intraday activity shapes without prices. Campaign026 reads only close-derived returns and a frozen return benchmark, and reads no amount.
Candidate49 measures causal cumulative-VWAP crossings from close, volume, and amount. Campaign026 reads no volume or amount and has no cumulative VWAP or crossing count.
Campaign026 contains one new close-plus-frozen-market statistic and no terminal factor value, transform, filter, model, or combination.
